propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous self-re-dispatch to hourly cron-triggered execution after RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS is disabled
Cron schedule in reconcile-bridge.yml requires consolidation from three 40-minute entries to a single hourly entry at minute 23 to avoid :00 contention

CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm becomes unfirable at hourly cadence without retune: must change from threshold=1/evaluation_periods=1 to threshold=0/evaluation_periods=2/datapoints_to_alarm=2 to maintain two-consecutive-failures detection
Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron, assert uniform 60-minute gaps, single schedule entry, and non-zero minute instead of echoing literal three-entry form
Documentation and comments referencing 40-minute bridge cadence must update to hourly; worst-case Jira<->rebar sync latency changes from ~40 minutes to 1 hour
Terraform Drift will remain red until terraform apply executes to deploy the retune CloudWatch alarm changes; bridge failures are unalarmed until this operator action completes
